query:
select coalesce(max(m.ordinal) + 1, count(m.*))::int as "next!"
               from sessions s
               join projects p on p.id = s.project_id
               left join messages m on m.session_id = s.id
               where s.id = $1
                 and ($2::uuid is null or group_visible(p.group_id, $2))
               group by s.id
